verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a self-hosted, local LLM inference engine (C/C++ library, CLI and server). It has no vendor-hosted production data tier, so a separate sandbox or test-mode environment is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability, which would otherwise make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
